note: Kabetogama State Forest campground on Wakemup Bay of Lake Vermilion, run from Bear Head Lake State Park: two wooded loops behind the day-use area's swimming beach, picnic pavilion and fishing pier, with a public boat landing just north. --Claude
summary: DNR record and facility map read: 21 sites (15 take RVs) in two wooded loops, vault toilet, seasonal water, closed Nov 22 to mid-May. The old note's 'boat-in' sites belong to Hinsdale Island, not here. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (sites sit behind the day-use beach and lawn). Pin confirmed; DNR link to hyphen form; phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview proposed (stored value is not --AWH). On the 2009 leaf-off frame (MnGeo neclr2009) and the DNR facility map, the campsites are in two loops in the woods south-east of the day-use area. The nearest sites, at the north-west end of the west loop (about 47.9011,-92.5890), sit 55-70 m from the water with the day-use lawn, picnic pavilion, parking and swimming beach between; the east loop (centre about 47.9007,-92.5866) is 120 m+ back in the trees. The old evidence ('open drive-in sites with grass apron + dock at the beach/shelter') describes the day-use area, not campsites. The day-use beach blocks on-water. A lakeview from the west loop's north end across the open day-use lawn is plausible but unconfirmed by any site photo; if the reviewer reads the lawn trees as a screen, the value would go to not waterfront.

NOTE: the old note's 'drive-in plus some boat-in' is wrong: the DNR record names Hinsdale Island as 'the only boat-in campsite' in the forest. Fees left ($17 state forest drive-in, DNR fee page 2026-10-12); the record shows fee: 1.
PIN 47.9012,-92.5887 sits at the north-west end of the west loop by the pavilion (DNR point 47.900952,-92.587001 is between the loops); confirmed.
